title: Whole application
scenario: A 34-control application (title, search field and buttons, options, features, levels, progress, status) on a 1920x1080 offscreen EmbeddedHost, reduced motion: 60 simulated seconds idle with nothing armed, 60 with the search field's caret, one more second at the native 10 ms timer period, then hidden. Proves G1 (nothing armed) and G13 (idle and hidden); cold start to the first presented frame is a separate receipt-only measurement.
drawCalls: not counted: frame.drawCalls is 0 without the counting wrappers

phases.name: warm
phases.description: the first frame and one more: first-use resources settle

phases.name: idle-nothing-armed
phases.description: nothing focused or animating: each step advances the fixture clock by 1 s, ticking only if the view asks for animation

phases.name: idle-focused-caret
phases.description: step 0 gives the search field logical focus (its caret); each step advances the fixture clock by 1 s, ticking only if the view asks for animation

phases.name: caret-timer-period
phases.description: the focused caret for one more second at the native dispatcher's 10 ms timer period: each step advances the clock by 10 ms, ticking only if the view asks for animation

videoMemory.reason: software adapter: rendering uses system memory, which privateBytes counts

memory.trackedLiveBytes: measured from the scene build onwards

timing.reason: timing comes only from performance-timing.ps1 on a hardware adapter in a quiet window (W0.2); counts and memory are recorded here

provenance.command: performance-fixtures.ps1 -Fixture FX13 -Variant default -Adapter Warp -FixtureHost embedded -Configuration 'Release' -Platform x64
